description: Reverse one recorded world-graph entity merge in a campaign you own. Pass the merge_id from chargen_merge_entities or chargen_list_entity_merges. Restores the archived source and moves recorded links back. Also reverses session renames recorded with that merge_id; subsequently edited text is skipped and reported in skipped_renames.
name: chargen_undo_entity_merge
title: Undo world entity merge
